_doc: Stage C: animate the approved frames. Seedance for performance + native audio, Kling Pro where start+end frames lock the action.

args.prompt: Static ceiling security camera, no camera movement. The golden retriever stares down the dark hallway, ears rising, then lowers its head and lets out a low rumbling growl; at the far end a faint glow slowly forms into a translucent ghost beagle. Black-and-white infrared night vision, sensor noise, slight flicker of the IR light. Audio: low dog growl, faint electrical hum of the camera, silent house. No music. Avoid generating any text or subtitles.

Static security camera. The translucent ghost beagle wags its tail and trots slowly toward the golden retriever, who tilts its head, sniffs the air, then wags back; both turn to look up at the treat jar on the side table. Ghost body stays semi-transparent and softly glowing. Black-and-white infrared night vision, fisheye, sensor noise. Sounds: soft paws on wood floor, curious whine.

Static ceiling security camera. The golden retriever and the translucent ghost beagle lie side by side chewing dog treats next to the tipped jar; the ghost's tail wags, a treat it holds is semi-transparent too; the retriever rests its head on its paws contentedly. Black-and-white infrared night vision, sensor noise. Audio: crunchy chewing, a happy sigh, quiet house. No music. Avoid generating any text or subtitles.
